repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-board
repository.purpose: Internal whiteboard plugin registered as webex.internal.board. It creates, lists, locks, keeps alive, and deletes board channels bound to a conversation ACL (routing create and list to the board cluster that matches the ACL cluster), adds and reads KMS-encrypted board contents in serial chunks, uploads board images and snapshots to Webex Files, authorizes a transcoder for whiteboard sharing to mobile, and carries live board activity over Mercury through its realtime child, either on a board socket of its own or on the shared Mercury socket. Its payload transformer creates each channel's content key and decrypts content reads.

integration.framework: karma (webex-legacy-tools --integration --runner karma; runs the unit and integration specs in browsers)
external_deps: live Webex services (board, ACL, Webex Files, KMS, Mercury)

board-internal-sdk.summary: Published npm package (internal plugin; README says semver is not strictly followed). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. Importing it imports the mercury, encryption, conversation, and feature plugins and registers Board as internal plugin 'board' with child realtime, the config in src/config.js, and the decryptContents and encryptChannel payload transformers. Exports are the default Board class and the named config and RealtimeChannel. The plugin API is webex.internal.board (channel, content, image, registration, shared-Mercury, and media-injector methods) and webex.internal.board.realtime (publish, connect, disconnect, activity routing). Per-method behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

board-service-http.source: Webex board service (catalog service 'board', or the cluster-local board service resolved from the conversation ACL cluster, plus per-channel channelUrl; route definitions are not in this repository)
board-service-http.summary: POST/GET /channels, GET/PATCH channelUrl, POST/GET/DELETE channelUrl/contents, POST channelUrl/lock?intent=delete, POST channelUrl/keepAlive, PUT channelUrl/spaces/open|hidden, POST channelUrl/register, PUT channelUrl/sharePolicies/transcoder, GET /ping, POST /registrations. Bodies are listed under Protocol and wire format in src/docs/README.md.

acl-links-http.source: Webex ACL service (the channel aclUrl returned by the board service; route definitions are not in this repository)
acl-links-http.summary: PUT <aclUrl>/links with {aclLinkType: INCOMING, linkedAcl, kmsMessage delete of the conversation authorization, aclLinkOperation: DELETE} removes the conversation-to-board link.

webex-files-upload.source: Webex Files upload sessions under the board space URL (reached through webex.upload; route definitions are not in this repository)
webex-files-upload.summary: Three-phase upload to <spaceUrl>/upload_sessions with qs transcode true and fileSize in initialize and finalize; the finalize response downloadUrl becomes the SCR loc.

mercury-board-activity.source: Mercury web socket frames for board bindings (Mercury service; framing owned by @webex/internal-plugin-mercury, module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-mercury/src/docs/README.md)
mercury-board-activity.summary: Outbound publishRequest frame {id, type: publishRequest, recipients [{alertType none, route binding, headers {}}], data {eventType board.activity, contentType, payload, envelope {encryptionKeyUrl, channelId}}}; inbound board.activity envelopes routed by envelope.channelId.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Board and RealtimeService extend WebexPlugin in namespace Board (config is webex.config.board); registerInternalPlugin merges config and concatenates payloadTransformer predicates and transforms; transforms without a direction match every direction; Page wraps list responses; webex.request and webex.upload carry every HTTP call.

webex-core-services.summary: getClusterId(aclUrl) and getServiceFromClusterId({clusterId}) resolve the cluster-local board URL; getServiceFromUrl(uri) identifies board requests for the encryptChannel predicate; catalog service 'board' is the fallback.

internal-plugin-encryption.source: @webex/internal-plugin-encryption (workspace package; no spec exists; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-encryption/src/encryption.js, src/kms.js, src/index.js)
internal-plugin-encryption.summary: encryptText, decryptText, encryptScr (rejects without scr.loc), decryptScr, encryptBinary resolving {scr, cdata}; kms.createUnboundKeys, prepareRequest, decryptKmsMessage, listAuthorizations, removeAuthorization; the encryptKmsMessage predicate skips a kmsMessage with empty keyUris and its transform wraps the message.

internal-plugin-mercury.summary: RealtimeChannel extends the Mercury class; connect(webSocketUrl) and disconnect() own socket lifecycle with timers from the plugin namespace config; the shared plugin exposes socket, localClusterServiceUrls, the online event, and event:board.activity.

internal-plugin-feature.summary: getFeature('developer', 'web-shared-mercury') resolves the toggle value, or null when unknown; a falsy value disables shared Mercury registration.

internal-plugin-conversation.source: @webex/internal-plugin-conversation (workspace package; no spec exists; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-conversation/src/index.js)
internal-plugin-conversation.summary: Imported only for its side effect of registering internal plugin 'conversation'. Callers pass conversation objects whose aclUrl and kmsResourceObjectUrl this module reads.

internal-plugin-device.source: @webex/internal-plugin-device (workspace package, not declared in package.json and registered through the mercury plugin import; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-device/src/docs/README.md)
internal-plugin-device.summary: deviceType is stamped on encrypted contents and webSocketUrl is sent on shared Mercury registration.

webex-common-utilities.summary: tap passes the original value through and never rejects; used around collection removal after disconnect.

ampersand-collection.summary: RealtimeChannelCollection extends it with mainIndex channelId and model RealtimeChannel.

es6-promise-series.summary: Called with an array of functions, it runs them one at a time and resolves the concatenation of their results; the first rejection rejects the series.

uuid.summary: v4 generates the id of each publishRequest frame.
